script_text: Stop, Taurus: a sweet invitation could collide with a serious career demand. Your ruling planet, Venus, moves through Scorpio in your solar 7th House of Partnerships, maintaining a square to Pluto in Aquarius in your 10th House of Career. For your Earth sign, this highlights the tension between loyalty and professional control. If single, you may attract someone magnetic through a professional introduction; ask whether they're genuinely available. If partnered, a discussion about working late could reveal who feels consistently overlooked. That 10th House pressure favors reviewing a client's conditions before accepting an assignment, especially clauses granting extra access to your time. A negotiation may expose an unpaid responsibility hiding behind an impressive title. Avoid promising a partner your evening before confirming exactly what your employer expects from you. Follow for tomorrow's reading and your next Taurus love forecast update.
